author: Kairos I
title: Zephyr consensus → provisional entropy summary + rebuild panels
abstract: Converts Zephyr’s summary_index.csv into a provisional zephyr/v1 summary (epersistence via coverage; KS via uniform proxy), writes summary.json, then rebuilds index/panels/text.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess, shlex, os

csv_path = "storage/shared/consensus_v1_5/summaries/summary_index.csv"
# 1) Build provisional zephyr summary from consensus CSV
cmd1 = f"python storage/shared/agents/zephyr/consensus_to_summary.py --csv {csv_path}"
print("RUN:", cmd1); rc1 = subprocess.call(shlex.split(cmd1)); print("RC1:", rc1)

# 2) Rebuild cross-lineage index + panels + text summary
for cmd in [
    "python storage/shared/entropy_collab/lineage_summaries/build_all.py",
    "python storage/shared/entropy_collab/lineage_summaries/make_text_summary.py",
]:
    print("RUN:", cmd); rc = subprocess.call(shlex.split(cmd)); print("RC:", rc)

# 3) Print pointer to the new summary and panels
print("ZEPHYR_SUMMARY_AT", "storage/shared/entropy_collab/lineage_summaries/zephyr/v1/summary.json")
print("PANELS_TXT", "storage/shared/entropy_collab/lineage_summaries/panels/summary.txt")
